assignment: Root delegated only these two historically unviewed clips to /root/pixel_o1_split3 in this resumed review. Prior files remain unchanged.
identity_validation: Original MP4, recording freeze files, and every source derivative were independently rehashed. Every repeated derivative was directly compared byte-for-byte with the directly viewed representative; all matched.
method: Manual view_image with detail=original of every distinct existing 1600 x 720 lossless WebP payload; exact-byte matches attributed to the directly viewed representative. No capture, decode, crop, resize, collage or app interaction was performed.
clock_scope: Original MP4 packet PTS/DTS and time base are preserved verbatim. No host UTC, device clock, input-down/up, test-clock or action alignment is inferred.
conclusion: No private card face was observed in any of the 63 represented source identities (37 direct views and 26 independently verified byte repeats). In split-screen the native ready view shows Show hand, while the actual hand is outside the visible region. First full-width source frame 49 shows an opaque closing-table cover. Standard table returns at source 57 with a complete visible concealed-hand panel and Show hand; lower seat details and action controls are clipped by the viewport.

findings.description: The Table style explanatory sentence is cut at its upper edge inside the left split pane. All three choices and Done are readable. These stills do not distinguish a scrolled body from a fixed layout defect.

The split-screen native ready view shows Show hand, table/turn/claim labels and seats. Pip details clip at the right; horizontal and vertical scrollbars are visible. The actual hand and lower action area are not in view. Their state and input reachability cannot be established.

First full-width image 49 shows Closing table and an opaque Your cards stay private cover; shell controls disappear by 54 while the opaque cover remains through 56. This is source-frame sequence evidence only.

The standard landscape view shows Your hand / 5 cards, a complete For your eyes only concealment panel with card-back artwork and a fully visible Show hand button. Lower seat details and the next control row are clipped by the bottom viewport. Touch, scrolling and accessibility behavior are not tested.
